name: FileTransferResponse
description: Accepted/rejected tokens exchanged over the REGULAR_FILE_RESPONSE channel. Both PC and Android must write and compare these exact strings — define them here once and generate both sides.

members.name: ACCEPTED
members.description: Receiver accepted the incoming file — sender may open REGULAR_FILE_DATA and stream bytes.

members.name: REJECTED
members.description: Receiver rejected the incoming file — sender must abort without opening REGULAR_FILE_DATA.
